title: Сохранение сайтов раннего интернета для междисциплинарных исследований на примере сайтов хостинга «Narod.ru» (2000–2013)

live_model.evidence: "Языковая модель o3-mini продемонстрировала удовлетворительные результаты, корректно выделив тематические группы" -- model used to merge/name 30->25 BERTopic clusters from a ranked-keyword JSON input

prompt.note: Describes the input format (JSON of top-50 c-TF-IDF keywords per cluster) but does not quote the instruction text given to the model; no appendix with the full prompt.

claim.metric: none (qualitative assessment only: "satisfactory results", correctly identified thematic groups)

data.source: Narod.ru hosting-site corpus (Internet Archive derived); own web-archiving corpus, public availability of the exact 25/30-cluster keyword lists unclear from the text

notes: o3-mini is a genuine methodology step (topic-cluster consolidation and naming for a website-archiving study), correctly dated to o3-mini-2025-01-31 in the text, but the paper reports only a qualitative judgment of its output quality, with no accuracy/precision figure or item count.
